API versions: 62.0 and 67.0. Anonymous Apex ran with --api-version 62.0/67.0 and called CollationProbe62/67 (class apiVersion 62.0/67.0); the named route ran CollationTest62/67, LocaleTest62/67 (class apiVersion matches). OrderResultException (apiVersion 62.0) only transports the anonymous output.
tooling: sf 2.157.8; scratch HOME with SF_USE_GENERIC_UNIX_KEYCHAIN=true. Not capture.sh: this run needed full raw messages and test users, so a direct sf driver was used (deploy, assign Probe_Access, apex run, apex run test, org delete).
timestamps (UTC, 2026-11-13): org created 02:57:52; first pass (superseded, see below) ended 03:01:12; final pass (every row in the TSV) ended 03:06:22; org deleted 03:11:15.
sources: generated probe packet. CollationProbe62.cls sha256 fe18a70a48ef6809..., CollationProbe67.cls sha256 ef00ceaa65704567... (first 16 hex digits).
metadata: Account.Probe_Text__c Text(255) and permission set Probe_Access (field access), deployed at source API 67.0.
mechanics: every value of a case is inserted in one list in a fixed shuffled order (seeded Python shuffle, written into the class as decimal UTF-16 code unit lists; maps/*-values.tsv decode each two-character label). Label (index, two base-36 characters) is stored in BillingCity (Contact: MailingCity). Output is the concatenated labels of SELECT ... ORDER BY <field> ASC, Id ASC and ORDER BY <field> DESC, Id ASC. DuplicateRuleHeader.allowSave=true, allOrNone=false. n: is the inserted count; fail:/lenmis: appear only if a save failed or a stored length differed (none did).
rows (tuning file, 70 data rows): anonymous 11 cases per API (facts, T1-T5, T6 x3, T7 x2) plus 7 repeats per API; named route 10 CollationTest cases plus 8 LocaleTest cases (T8) per API; repeats of T1, T2, T4, T5, T6 name, T7 name and the holdout were run as fresh transactions and agree with the first runs (40 cells, 0 differences between routes, repeats and API versions after masking test:true/false).
sealed holdout: 40 strings, run on both routes at both APIs, plus one anonymous repeat per API; results are NOT in this directory. They are held outside this repository. Ties inside case-equal groups follow Id order and Id order is not always insert order, so tie members can appear in either label order. Compare by case-folded key group, not by label.
first-pass note: an earlier pass wrote Probe_Text__c in the T8 insert. At API 62.0 the Standard User runAs inserts succeeded. At API 67.0 every one of the 30 inserts per user failed with "Operation failed due to fields being inaccessible on Sobject" (no FLS for the new field). One run per API; not repeated; the T8 rows in the TSV come from the final pass, which does not touch Probe_Text__c under runAs. Possible FLS enforcement difference between API 62 and 67 for DML in Apex; unverified.
non-claims: nothing about SOSL, LIKE, restricted picklists, or characters outside the sets in maps/. Apex List<String>.sort() was recorded as a control only (binary code point order).

Evidence limit: the M group representatives establish A rather than a and Z rather than z in the captured groups. The binary-smallest representative for other merged spellings is provisional. No native HAVING row is supplied; HAVING coverage checks the local contract that predicate evaluation retains the query execution locale.

Follow-up: ../group_representative/org.tsv records additional case variants, reversed insertion and ID assignment at API 62.0 and 67.0 on both routes. Other merged spellings remain unproven.
